neighbours.label: A kilogram unit token (kg, kilogram) after a number or 'per'
fire: The recommended dose is 10 mg per kg every eight hours.
Our suitcase weighed 23 kg at the check-in desk.
She lost almost six kilograms during the expedition.
Farmers sold potatoes at two euros per kilogram this year.
Each crate can carry about 40 kg of apples.
Soil samples contained 120 becquerels per kg of caesium.
A typical adult brain weighs about 1.4 kg in total.
quiet: The recommended dose is two tablets every eight hours.
Our suitcase measured 70 cm at the check-in desk.
She walked almost six miles during the expedition.
Farmers sold potatoes at two euros per sack this year.
Each crate can carry about 40 pounds of apples.
The newborn calf stood up within 35 minutes.
Soil samples contained 120 litres of water per cubic metre.
A typical adult brain uses about 20 percent of our energy.

notes: Near misses swap in other units (cm, miles, pounds, litres) or none.
